content:
Since this summer I've frequently been having issues with lean crashing. I open VSCode, it freezes, and then fails with an error message which according to the logs is "2026-09-24 14:28:06.758 [error] CodeWindow: renderer process gone (reason: killed, code: 9)"

What kind of troubleshooting should I do to fix this? Does anyone have ideas? I tried reinstalling the lean extension via two different methods (directly via VSCode and also via the AUR package) and that didn't fix it. I believe the problem is something to do with the lean extension and not with VSCode overall, but I admit I don't use VSCode for much else so it's a larger issue than I think.

Do you use apps like Claude Code or codex? In my experience the new models are quite good at solving computer-related problems like this. If you don't use these things and if googling the error doesn't help, we'll have to wait for a human expert to chip in.
You'll likely need to follow https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/wiki/Native-Crash-Issues#creating-and-symbolicating-local-crash-reports to get any information useful to troubleshoot
